proof_audit.v13-c10-revelation: Pass. The direct mechanism commits to simulating the selected original strategies, with independent private random seeds. Every false report induces a feasible original message distribution; averaging dominance gives expected DSIC, and the Bayesian comparison retains the law conditional on the true type. No independence is needed for composition itself. Measurable kernels, absolute integrability, pointwise versus a.e. qualifications and unsimulated message/action costs are explicit. Selected outcome distributions are reproduced without claiming seedwise, unique or full implementation.
proof_audit.v13-c10-groves: Pass. With payments from buyers, true-own/reported-others welfare less a report-independent constant equals utility, so the chosen global welfare maximizer dominates every false-report outcome. Known cost is included in that comparison but spent once in the resource ledger. Pivot IR follows only from the stated removal embedding, unchanged others/cost, nonnegative own value and zero outside utility. Both finite assignment removal problems and the actually endowed project account are explicit; a deficit example is not a universal budget-balance impossibility theorem.
proof_audit.v13-c10-payment: Pass. Cross-report inequalities imply allocation monotonicity and squeeze utility increments. The Riemann-sum gap is bounded by mesh times total allocation variation, establishing the envelope including every jump and endpoint. Integral bounds prove all-report sufficiency. Bottom utility fixes the payment constant and IR. The characterization concerns expected mechanism outcomes; the posted-price lottery separately has seedwise truthfulness/IR. The funded side bet is BIC/interim-IR under independence but fails DSIC and later rejection rights.
proof_audit.v13-c10-optimal: Pass after the two recorded coordinator precision repairs. Independence gives a common opponent law for interim IC. Bounded allocation/rent and separate per-report/ex-ante absolute payments justify the expected identity and interchange. Finite interior virtual products suffice almost surely; zero-density or infinite-ranking endpoints use allocation-integral payments. The feasible pointwise upper bound covers every stipulated BIC/interim-IR mechanism. Monotone virtual ranking and normalized critical payments attain it with fixed zero/tie conventions. The iid reserve is a generalized crossing threshold, not necessarily a zero. Known sale cost shifts the net objective once; no general ironing or multi-object optimality is asserted.
proof_audit.v13-c10-revenue: Pass. Common interim allocation and bottom utility imply equal payments only within the declared independent, money-linear, integrable class. Winning-conditional prices require the winning probability; all-pay adds losing payments. For both bidder counts the candidate objectives have derivative k z^(k-1)(v-z)/H^k, and the complete zero, support-endpoint and above-support bid arguments prove global best replies. Three distinct receipt integrals agree. Second-price truth is a statewise monetary comparison, not an equilibrium uniqueness claim.
proof_audit.v13-c10-preferences: Pass. CARA is defined for all real gains, so overbids have no hidden utility-domain exclusion. The exact strict improvement at an interior type extends by continuity to a positive-mass open set, refuting even an a.e. equilibrium assertion. For general differentiable strictly concave utility, strict supporting-tangent separation gives u(s)-s u'(s)>0 and the profitable local direction for each interior type. This neither solves a new symmetric equilibrium nor determines its revenue ranking. Increasing utility preserves second-price statewise dominance.
